definitions.gloss: to jump up; to spring up
definitions.explanation: To leap upward suddenly or energetically.
When prices, numbers, or statistics increase sharply.

definitions.gloss: to flip up; to fly up
definitions.explanation: When something hinged or loose springs upward.

notes:
{跳|は}ね{上|あ}がる is an intransitive verb (⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧). The transitive form is {跳|は}ね{上|あ}げる (to flip up, to jack up).

ASPECT (ている):
{跳|は}ね{上|あ}がっている indicates an ongoing or resulting state of being elevated or having jumped up.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{椅子|いす}→椅子：00706_isu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{跳|は}ね{上|あ}がる - to jump up from a chair
- ⟦{値段|ねだん}→値段：00871_nedan⟧/⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{跳|は}ね{上|あ}がる - prices surge
- {跳|は}ね{上|あ}がり⟦{式|しき}→〜式：02000_shiki⟧ - flip-up type (of glasses, etc.)

COMPOUND VERB STRUCTURE:
⟦{跳|は}ねる→跳ねる：04378_haneru⟧ (to jump) + ⟦{上|あ}がる→上がる：00615_agaru⟧ (to go up) = {跳|は}ね{上|あ}がる (to jump up)

RELATED:
- ⟦{飛|と}び{上|あ}がる→飛び上がる：06345_tobiagaru⟧ - to jump up (similar meaning)
- {跳|は}ね{上|あ}げる - to flip up (transitive)
